title: Oil and gas company drills beside the mesa drill site
place_text: northern border of Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: all of a sudden an oil and gas company appears, ramrods permits through

plain: Right beside the spot on a mesa where the ranch was drilling, an oil and gas company suddenly showed up and "ramrods permits through" to drill on the northern border of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events. The ranch's owner tells Michels he watched this happen, and it would mean outsiders were taking an interest in what lies under the ground there.
